name: BSP_SceneFile_Read
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol, and provisional: identified from its literals and its three call sites, the 0x1062-byte body was not read. Packet mission_scene_load, read-only analysis. __thiscall(this=[00e18680], const char* scenePath, 0, char, void* sceneRecord, const char* override, char); the 004dfb70 call site at 004e01d7 passes ([game+5FCh]+910h, 0, 0, game+5FCh, game+604h, 0) and 004d4df0 makes the other two passes with the last-but-three and last arguments toggled. 24 string immediates including SceneBrowserGroups, groups, entity, LandVehicle, LandFort, CommandBuilding, VehicleClass, traffic and g_Terrain.ga_StaticShadowShotSize, in segment 6 whose keywords are groupname, scenebrowsergroups, browsergroup, spawnpoint. Three callers: 004d4df0, 004dfb70, 004e1d70. docs/MISSION_SCENE_LOAD.md. | Body read for packet scene_file_reader. __thiscall, RET 0x18: (this=[00e18680], const char* scenePath, void* a2, char instantiate, void* sceneRecord, const char* overrideName, char registration). The .scn file is plain text; the tokenizer 008d9cf0 is constructed with the delimiter set ";{}=:(,)" (00ce4f40). Three passes selected by arguments 3 and 6: (0,0) header only, the entity loop skipped at 0046e9d5; (0,1) header plus entities in registration mode, stopping at the first traffic/groups/SceneBrowserGroups; (1,0) header, full entity construction, all four tail blocks, then 0046aab0. Top-level dispatch: header 00ce5994 -> 00469bf0, entity 00ce5818 -> 0046cf40, traffic 00ce5890 -> 009514b0 (or 0095ca10 on pass 2), groups 00ce55e4 -> 00467e10, SceneBrowserGroups 00ce56a4 -> 00469e40. Prologue: 0046a9f0 on this+14Ch, the path split on the last "." into this+13Ch/+140h and this+144h/+148h, then the Weathers walk of SCRIPTS\datatables\Weather.lua (00ce59dc) which, with no override name, writes the four g_Terrain.* console variables g_StaticShadowTexture, ga_StaticShadowShotOffsetX, ga_StaticShadowShotOffsetZ and ga_StaticShadowShotSize. All 259 installed .scn files parse under the recovered grammar. See docs/SCENE_FILE_READER.md. | Run-time evidence, bsp_game.exe milestone 2e (packet cc_exe_2e). The header pass ran in process over the installed universe/Scenes/missions/USN/usn_2_java.scn, 48680 bytes read through the mounted VFS: header uniqueID 1 reached the scene record at +1098h, nextUID 2, a properties block and no precache block, and the reader recovered no errors. The whole document behind that header holds 34 top-level entity blocks in two classes (DestroyerGen x32, NavPoint x2), one traffic block and one SceneBrowserGroups token, matching src/mission_scene_probe.cpp exactly. Correction to the owner column of mission_load_host_steps: this step needs the reader and the VFS only, so the scene-graph owner is first required by the passes inside 004D4DF0, not here.
